import json,tempfile
from pathlib import Path
from src import order_service,storage
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
 path=Path(directory)/"orders.sqlite"
 connection=storage.connect(path)
 order_service.create_order(connection,"ORDER-1")
 order_service.cancel_order(connection,"ORDER-1")
 before=order_service.read_status(connection,"ORDER-1")
 trace=[]
 connection.set_trace_callback(trace.append)
 accepted=order_service.submit_order(connection,"ORDER-1")
 connection.close()
 reopened=storage.connect(path)
 after=order_service.read_status(reopened,"ORDER-1")
 reopened.close()
 print(json.dumps({"before_submit":before,"accepted":accepted,"submit_sql_trace":trace,"reopened_status":after},indent=2))
